stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In 2026-11-03T11:33:01Z–11:38:01Z, sum by (service_name, status_code) increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[5m]) returned checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 238.749; STATUS_CODE_ERROR increases were also 0 for ad, cart, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment and recommendation.

The raw cumulative series sum by (status_code) traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"} is flat at 405 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR across all 21 samples in 11:33:01Z–11:38:01Z at a 15s step, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET rises 40554 -> 40745, showing no error span was added in the window.

Checkout's client RPC metrics in the window show rpc_grpc_status_code=0 counts for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (18.75), oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (56.25), oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (18.75) and /EmptyCart (18.75), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (37.5), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (18.75) and /ShipOrder (18.75), while the error-status series PaymentService/Charge status 2 and CartService/EmptyCart status 9 both have increase 0.

Checkout's server side is not erroring: increase(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count[5m]) for service_name=checkout shows oteldemo.CheckoutService rpc_grpc_status_code=0 at 18.75 and rpc_grpc_status_code=13 at 0.

Trace 0d58d7f48b2efb9e9244c311d18e949c is an all-OK checkout request: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 82445us with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, checkout child oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 23273us status 0, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 7836us status 0, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 5650us status 0, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 1176us status 0, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert status 0, checkout HTTP POST http 200, email POST /send_order_confirmation http 200, and frontend POST /api/checkout http 200.

Traces 1e439f339fd98d05bece5e4f5dab7a23 (checkout PlaceOrder 53978us) and ed3b9f2f4f15711479410248d50a5b2f (checkout PlaceOrder 15127us) show only rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and http.status_code 200 spans, including payment Charge (7343us and 1338us), cart EmptyCart/GetCart, shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder, product-catalog GetProduct, currency Convert with otel.status_code OK, and email POST /send_order_confirmation http 200.
